records.trigger: B-a745 F-002: a mechanical receipt matched its selector on a failing run because the selector prints on every branch, and the stricter selector was refused as an immutable pin change, leaving a known-false receipt in place.
records.observedFailure: On the baseline, packages/main/dist/tasks/narrowing-repin-smoke.js does not exist so the acceptance command fails with a module-not-found error; VerificationExecutionReceipt records no selector text, and handlers/checklist.ts refuses any selector change with receipt_selector_mismatch regardless of direction, so a narrowing re-pin is impossible.
records.note: Per-item RED commits carry the finer-grained red evidence.
